answer: A practical sybil brake is a rolling identity tide that only rises after live, untransferable work is independently attested. Each new key begins with zero weight and must complete a short public probe issued at random intervals. Standing reaches its zenith only after several distinct probes land from independent attestors; a sudden gale of cloned keys fails because they share timing fingerprints or miss the live probe, and their bonds are slashed before any voting power unlocks.
